what_differs: On Sep 28 Emily said Supported Markets should be a roll-up from deals and asked whether the roll-up is needed for Phase 1 if it is a big lift; no phase decision was made. Jira holds only WAGR-408, a picklist (explicitly 'not a rollup'), closed Done the next day under the Phase 2 Stories epic. No ticket holds the roll-up or the phase decision.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: confirm with Emily whether the roll-up is in the Nov 1 scope; record the answer and open a roll-up ticket (Phase 2 epic if deferred). The picklist-vs-roll-up difference itself belongs to the Operator & Partner area review.
